person_note: The controlling narration is third person. q04784, q04785, and q04797 provide sustained external narration of Decker, Jamison, and other characters, while the authorized CrimeReads interior excerpt confirms the same mode. First- and second-person forms elsewhere occur in dialogue or general sayings, not autonomous narrative sections. No evidence of a participating narrator, sustained second-person narration, or alternating-person structure was found. The main limitation is the absence of an explicit whole-book structural description, but the authorized sustained excerpt and distinct Goodreads passages agree without credible contrary evidence.
